items.message: Areas most at risk include low lying areas in Tetbury, Badminton, Brook End at Luckington, Corsham, Lacock and the road at Reybridge. Further flooding is possible overnight and on Saturday in response to recent rainfall.

items.description: Tributaries on the Upper River Thames above Cricklade
items.message:
High river levels may lead to flooding.

Flooding of low lying land and roads is possible tonight, Friday 20 November 2026, along the Swill Brook. The next 24 hours is expected to be mostly dry with the chance of a few light rain showers. We expect river levels to remain high throughout the day.

We are monitoring the situation. Avoid using low lying footpaths and any bridges near local watercourses.

This message will be updated by 10:00am on Saturday 21 November 2026 or as the situation changes.
